name: todo-list-app
description: Weekly task planner with a React client and a Node/Express API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:memory -w server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
